about: The handhelds zyperos.com shows, first the default. mk/site_devices.py builds the page's device parts from this list: the hero's handheld and its row of picks, the facts, the tour's and galleries' screenshots, the marks on what a handheld doesn't have yet, the install step and its FAQ. Adding a handheld is one entry here and its files: its model (tools/build-<id>-model.py writes the .glb, the poster and its thumbnail) and its captures in res/readme/<captures>/, by the first handheld's names (tools/readme-shots.py with DEVICE set to its id). Keys: missing names what the page offers that it doesn't have yet (the data-needs marks in site/index.html; null for the plain mark, or the mark's own words); lines replaces a data-line element's words for it; swap uses another capture in a screen's place; alts gives a capture its own description. model.studio sets the 3D model's light on the page (site/pixel2.js): env, its studio reflections; tone, on its colours; softbox, the light its face mirrors; coat, its clear coat; tuned until its face is its colour's hex.

devices.install: The Brick's graphics and Wi-Fi need closed files made for its chips, which ZyperOS doesn't pass on. The installer downloads them from where they are published and puts them only on your card.
devices.after_install: Take the card out, and the Brick starts its own system, as before.

faq.q: Does it run on the TrimUI Brick?
a: Yes, from 1.0.6: the TrimUI Brick (TG3040), from its own microSD card. It never writes to the Brick's own storage. Pick it in ZyperOS Installer, which adds the closed files its graphics and Wi-Fi need. The 3D systems are hidden on it for now, and ports, Flash Drive, Screen Colors, the old-screen shaders, NES Player 2, the charge limit and its lights are not there yet. Nobody has tried Bluetooth headphones on it yet. The Brick Hammer runs the same card, but nobody has tried one yet either. Not the Brick Pro yet.
I don't have a Brick myself: players on the ZyperOS Discord test it for me, and their logs show me what to fix.
